title: Bee Removal in Scarsdale, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Scarsdale, Westchester. Licensed experts treat and remove nests from homes and properties. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal services throughout Scarsdale, NY, protecting your family and property from stinging insect nests. Our licensed technicians treat and remove nests from residential and commercial properties in Westchester County with targeted, effective methods. Whether you've discovered wasps in your attic, yellow jackets in a wall void, carpenter bees drilling into trim, or ground-nesting bees in your yard, we offer fast response and complete nest removal — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
whyUs: With over 15 years serving Westchester communities, Best Pest Control NYC combines local expertise with proven bee removal techniques that prioritize safety and prevention. Our Scarsdale clients trust us for same-day service, transparent pricing, and guaranteed results that keep bees from returning.
localContext: Scarsdale's beautiful tree-lined streets and historic homes, from the Heathcote area to Fox Meadow, provide ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, and carpenter bees during warmer months. The village's mix of Tudor and Colonial-style residences, along with properties near the Bronx River Parkway and Scarsdale Golf Club, often experience seasonal wasp and hornet nest activity in soffits, eaves, wall voids, and attic spaces requiring professional treatment and removal. Carpenter bees target exposed wood trim and fascia on older homes. Ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize landscaped beds and lawn edges throughout the village.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Scarsdale?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Scarsdale?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to wasp and hornet problems in Scarsdale?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Scarsdale and Westchester County. If you're experiencing an urgent stinging insect situation near your home or business, call (855) 930-5016 immediately and we'll prioritize your safety.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects do you treat in Scarsdale homes?
faqs.answer: We treat wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, bald-faced hornets, paper wasps, carpenter bees, ground-nesting bees, and bumble bees. Our licensed technicians identify the species and locate the nest, then treat nests in walls, attics, soffits, eaves, chimneys, ground burrows, and wood galleries. Entry points are sealed after treatment to prevent recolonization.
